store.name: Qorelly Store
delivery: Ilorin: same day for orders placed before 2pm, ₦1,500.
Other cities in Nigeria: 2–4 working days, ₦3,500.
returns: Return unused items within 7 days of delivery for a full refund.
Wellness and health items can be returned only if the seal is unbroken.
Refunds go back to the original payment method within 3 working days.
payment: Card, bank transfer or pay on delivery (Ilorin only).

products.description: A relaxed two-piece in soft cotton, hand-dyed with indigo using the traditional resist method. Every set has small differences in pattern, so no two are the same.
features: Hand wash cold, dry in shade

products.name: Shea butter and black soap kit
products.summary: Raw shea butter and ose dudu black soap for everyday skin care.

products.description: A compact kit for the home or car with plasters, gauze, antiseptic, burn gel, a thermometer and paracetamol. Everything is labelled and in date for at least a year.
